instruction: Pick up the conch shell by 10 cm.

arguments.note: The conch is the small cream-colored shell left of the statue. Move the left hand above its estimated location.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 37 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The previous motion stopped short. Finish moving above the shell before turning downward.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 17 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The hand is above the shell. Begin rotating toward a straight-down grasp in free space.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 33 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: Continue turning downward while clear of the objects; the previous rotation was only partly executed.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The larger rotation was refused. Try a smaller downward rotation from the measured pose.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shell appears slightly left and behind the hand. Lower the open hand toward it while retaining clearance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: With the hand lower and closer to its base, rotate nearer to vertical for a secure shell grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Finish aligning the jaws vertically before the final approach.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The slight remaining tilt is usable. Approach the shell body with open jaws, stopping above contact.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shell is centered between the jaws. Lower toward its sides for grasping.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Make a small final descent so the jaws overlap the shell rather than closing above it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Close the jaws around the shell at the current grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: Lift a few millimetres first to check whether the shell follows the closed jaws.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shell did not clearly rise with the jaws. Reopen to grasp farther onto its body.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: Shift toward the shell's central body, which is behind and slightly right of the jaw center in the wrist view.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shell body is now aligned with the jaws. Lower to engage its thicker sides.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Descend another few millimetres to place the pads around the shell sides.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Close around the shell body at the corrected, lower grasp position.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The jaws are held apart by the shell, indicating contact. Begin a small test lift.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Continue lifting slowly while the shell settles between the pads.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shell now follows the hand and the grasp width is stable. Lift it beyond 10 cm above its starting height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shell slipped and landed left of its previous position. Reapproach its center for a lower, deeper grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The shell shifted right during the approach. Center the open jaws over its body before descending further.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The hand is being deflected by contact. Lift clear so both jaws can open fully before retrying.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shell is now clear of the jaws and lies farther right. Align over its narrower body and lower the open hand.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lower the jaws alongside the shell's narrower middle.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Take a deeper grasp around the shell, closing after the final small descent.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Test the deeper grasp with a small upward motion before the full lift.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shell remains between the pads. Raise the secured shell to exceed the requested 10 cm lift.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.
